result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but two horizontal carousel areas look awkwardly clipped at the right viewport edge.

issues.description: The category row ends with an unlabeled sliver of the next pill at the right edge, making it look like a broken or empty control.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or initial scroll position so enough of the next category and its label is visible, or clip the next item completely.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off aggressively, including its restaurant name and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Use a narrower card width or a deliberate partial-card preview with consistent right padding so the clipping reads clearly as horizontal scrolling.
